name: mail-pickup-agent
description: A Node.js executable that acts as a mail pickup agent for MailEnable, intercepting emails and routing them to quarantine or release.

scripts.postinstall: node -e "const f=require('fs'),p=f.existsSync('config/rules.json'),s=f.existsSync('config/rules.json.sample');if(!p&&s){f.copyFileSync('config/rules.json.sample','config/rules.json');console.log('Created config/rules.json from sample. Edit it or use the rules editor to configure your rules.');}"

author: Chuck Carlin
